name: Test Dungeon (Surface Cave, 512x512, upper-left)
description: MVP1 dungeon preset for tools/scripts/mapgen/test-dungeon-roundtrip.bat. Paints a 512x512 surface cave (HighMountain ring + Cave-biome horseshoe corridor) in the upper-left of the Felucca map. Palette derived from real Felucca dumps at (5694,325) and (6155,762). v3 fix: Biome Altitude Jitter is now enabled with CaveJitter=2 so 0x0244 floor tiles render as tan land-art (not solid black stretched-art). MountainJitter=0 keeps the wall band flat-rendered which works fine for 0x022C-0x022F. Pair with test-paint-dungeon.ps1 -Size 512.
